java_upgrade_guide.overview: This guide instructs Bob to perform a Java runtime version upgrade from 1.8 to 17 using OpenRewrite AST recipes — entirely within Bob's native capabilities. No premium package required. This is Phase 0 of the modernization workflow and must be completed BEFORE full application modernization.
java_upgrade_guide.when_to_apply: Apply this guide when the user asks to: - Upgrade the Java version of the legacy-netbanking project - Run the Java upgrade step of the modernization - Do Step 4.3 of the lab - Prepare the codebase for Spring Boot migration

phase_0_java_upgrade.title: Java Runtime Upgrade — Java 1.8 to Java 17

step.look_for: - Current java.version or maven.compiler.source/target values - Existing plugins block - Current dependency versions that may conflict with Java 17

step.action: Add OpenRewrite Maven plugin to pom.xml

step.expected_output: OpenRewrite will automatically: - Rewrite deprecated API usages to Java 17 equivalents - Replace javax.* with jakarta.* where applicable - Update language constructs to modern Java syntax - Report a list of all files modified

fix.action: Ensure scope is provided, version compatible with Tomcat 10+

step.success_criteria: BUILD SUCCESS with zero compilation errors
step.on_failure: Read the error output, identify the specific class and line causing failure, apply targeted fix using apply_diff, then re-run.

step.action: Generate Mermaid audit flowchart of all upgrade changes
step.required_content: - Source version (Java 1.8) and target version (Java 17) - Mermaid flowchart showing the upgrade pipeline - Table listing every file changed and what changed - Build validation result
step.mermaid_template: ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Legacy Java 1.8 Codebase] --> B[pom.xml: compiler source/target → 17] B --> C[OpenRewrite UpgradeToJava17 recipe] C --> D[AST transformations applied to source files] D --> E{Dependency conflicts detected?} E -- Yes --> F[Fix incompatible dependency versions] E -- No --> G[mvn clean package] F --> G G --> H{Build result} H -- SUCCESS --> I[✅ Java 17 upgrade complete — ready for modernization] H -- FAILURE --> J[Fix compilation errors] J --> G ```

java_upgrade_guide.integration_with_modernization: After this guide completes successfully: - The legacy-netbanking codebase is on Java 17 - The pom.xml has modern compiler settings - All deprecated Java 8 APIs are rewritten - Proceed immediately to Phase 1 of the modernization_workflow (full Spring Boot migration) - The Modernization Architect mode's other rule files (phases 1-7) take over from here
java_upgrade_guide.bob_capabilities_used: This entire upgrade is achieved using Bob's native capabilities: - read_file / apply_diff — for pom.xml modifications - execute_command — for running mvn OpenRewrite recipes and build validation - write_file — for generating the audit report No premium package, no external workflow engine, no AMA required.
